fields.description:
All versions < 2.31.0 will be deprecated with the next regular sprint release. All versions between 2.31.0 and 2.58.0 have to get a notification in notification center to update the app once a new activity is registered. This has to be implemented for the next 10 sprints, after that all versions below 2.58. have to be deprecated. 



Title: An important note for you!

Body: We noticed that you are using an out-of-date version of the app. Please update it so that every relevant feature keeps working!
